notes: «عنهما» points back to two men named in an earlier chain not written here: kept as a back_reference, not completed from the THQ English.
«حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» : the father is named only by relation (rule 7).
«أبي عبد الله» after «عن» inside the chain is a narrator (owner ruling 2); «قال إنه كان لله رسولا» is his saying.

fixes.reason: THQ's English names three co-transmitters at this point (Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa, Muhammad b. Husain, Ya'qub b. Yazid); the Arabic writes only «عنهما» (back-reference) here.

evidence.quote: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْهُمَا جَمِيعاً
from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, and Ya’qub ibn Yazid
